item.title: A long summary
item.description: This summary runs well past the length the Feeds app keeps, so the build cuts it at a word boundary and adds three dots. The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog, and then does it again, and again, because a fixture needs words. Packing a lot of words into one paragraph like this is how feeds that send the whole article look. The end of this sentence should never reach the page at all.
